description: A complete richly colored pixel art LANDSCAPE SCENE, like a miniature side-view game background filling the entire rectangular canvas. A rift ocean: a small wooden fishing boat on deep purple waves with one bright turquoise spatial crack and pink-violet glow in a dark sky. Indigo, purple and luminous teal. Strict crisp pixel clusters, rich clean colors, three distinct shades per material, dark warm selective contour, a readable simple silhouette at tiny original size. Slightly elevated side view, edge-to-edge scenic composition with sky in top third, distant shore across middle, broad water in bottom half. Opaque full background, not an isolated object. No button frame, no text, no people, no animals, no fish. Beautiful handcrafted 16-bit fishing scenery.
negative_description: text, letters, numbers, watermark, border, UI frame, photograph, blur, messy dithering, tiny noise, cropped edges, gray or white background, muddy colors
